label: preparing
what: A coordinated residents' gathering with refreshments and a private community presentation at eighteen sharp in the town hall. The innkeeper is arranging an escort and requests no early arrival; baker, freight and builder appear involved in bread and grain preparations. The secretary knowingly helps with scheduling and escort coordination, but may not know the private presentation's contents. A celebration of my forty years as mayor is plausible but unconfirmed; the gathering itself has been disclosed, its presentation details have not.
